comments.snippet: This crash occurs in WeifenLuo.WinFormsUI.Docking.DockPane.set_ActiveContent — third-party DockPanelSuite NuGet package. The ObjectDisposedException is a race condition when clicking a tab for a window that was already disposed. This is a known DockPanelSuite issue and cannot be fixed in our codebase.
